catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

objects.name: Argonaut
objects.description: Rovan’s ONE Bastion-derived Argonaut, refitted with his newfound wealth. UNIQUE silhouette: elongated rigid bronze Zeppelin central hull, two shorter side gun hulls, wedge-shaped armoured ram prow and reinforced lower keel; crimson lacquer side armour between bronze ribs, low protected command citadel, TWO exposed green magnetic stabiliser rings near the stern, FOUR articulated bronze vectoring thruster pods with green Type B glow, rebuilt gun positions. Veymarch SILVER broken shield/eight-point star on crimson banners. Workshop-built industrial machinery, not ornate fantasy gold or a generic round-nosed Bastion. HEAVY CANNON UPGRADE: two prominent twin-barrel heavy gun turrets on the upper foredeck, four huge long bronze-and-black cannon barrels, much thicker and longer than standard Bastion deck guns, with reinforced recoil cradles and visible mechanical breeches. Keep the wedge prow and crimson plating. These are conventional heavy cannons, not new magical weapons.
constraints: Exactly one Argonaut. The three captured Bastions may appear alongside it only in explicitly post-surrender fleet scenes. No wooden hulls, sails or extra vessels.
Same ship after a refit, never an additional capital ship.
All hull armour is bronze Type A; machinery is green Type B. No silver Type C hull or invulnerability.
Canonical Argonaut refit design controls hull geometry; older generic Bastion art supplies ancestry only.
Keep the wedge prow, crimson side armour, paired green stern stabiliser rings and vectoring pods recognisable in every new exterior view.
The enlarged heavy cannons must be conspicuous in exterior views; do not shrink them to decorative small deck guns.
The refit takes a legendary FOURTEEN DAYS, using captured resources; it is the same existing ship.
